families.topic: benzyl chloride exposure and incident response
families.page_title: Benzyl chloride: properties and incident management
evidence_points: The official UKHSA page provides information on benzyl chloride for use when responding to chemical incidents.
The page is published by the UK Health Security Agency on GOV.UK.
The publication was first published on 1 July 2014.
The GOV.UK record shows a latest update of 31 January 2025.
The publication provides general information and incident management material.
The linked material supports substance-specific assessment of health effects, exposure and incident response for benzyl chloride.
Benzyl chloride is also known as alpha-chlorotoluene and chlorophenylmethane.
The official page was live-opened successfully on 31 July 2026 and retained the title “Benzyl chloride: properties and incident management”.
An alert, symptom, exposure report, incident notification or checklist alone does not establish that every recommendation on Benzyl chloride: properties and incident management applies.
